mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 33 degrees. We are expecting an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city business, the Plan Commission is set to review the Sub-Zero site plan for Liberty Business Park on December 7th, while the Municipal Court reminds residents that O W I tickets require a personal appearance.

We have a busy lineup ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market on November 14, and an exciting John Denver tribute concert at the High School on November 15.
Looking at recent reports, on October 22, a vehicle crashed into a Metro bus on West Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for failure to yield.
Today's delicious flavor was Devil's Food Cake. Since we are closed for the evening, please join us tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will be serving Raspberry Cheesecake.
